text: {"lessons":["I sold several profitable positions early, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should follow a forward-looking plan instead of trying to lock in a win.","I should assess each stock by its prospects and role in my whole portfolio, not by whether it is above or below my purchase price.","The account's small ups and downs have not provided a reliable trading signal. I should avoid reacting to noise and make measured decisions consistent with my risk tolerance."]}
